name: DB-Views: Dashboards, Data Tables and Webforms
author: Dave

sections.description:
Deby.AI Home | Data Table Features | Live Database Demos | Create a FREE Deby.AI Account

Key Features

  • Add full database functionality to your website.
  • Deby.AI Generative AI copilot turns your data into powerful database apps.
  • Display advanced dashboards, data tables and multistep webforms in any webpage.

Build fast

  • A generative AI copilot turns your ideas and data into powerful apps — no coding skills needed.

  • Describe it freely, in your native language. Debi.AI brings it to life in no time!

Key Features

  • Display and edit table data in a frame embedded in any webpage.
  • Fully customize your tables. Enjoy complete language localization.
  • Create multistep web forms to edit data or add new rows.
  • Responsive Material 3 implementation makes tables look great on any device.
  • Enjoy fast drag & drop development. With our low-code solution, JavaScript coding skills are only required for advanced scenarios.

Handle Multi-Source Data

  • Build your apps by uploading your current data to Deby.AI. Supported formats: SQL dumps, JSON, XML, CSV, OpenOffice, LibreOffice, Excel, Google Sheets, and OneDrive spreadsheets.
  • You can also link your existing database servers: Azure/Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle Database, Amazon Athena, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, MariaDB, MongoDB, GraphQL, and more (full database & data sources list). A live copy of the data will be displayed.

Enjoy a FREE Starter License

  • Access the full power of Deby.AI at no cost — no credit card needed.
  • Built apps can be used indefinitely for medium-scale production.
sections.installation:
To install the DB-Views Data Table plugin:

  1. Open the Plugins panel of the WordPress Admin dashboard and click Add new. Search for “database views and webforms” and click the Install button.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins panel.
  3. To test-drive with the demo app, insert the following shortcode to any WordPress page:
    [db-views show=”app=lndz”]

To create your own views and apps:

  1. Create a Deby.AI share link.
  2. Copy the share link to the clipboard.
  3. In the desired webpage, create a WordPress shortcode like this:
    [db-views show=”your share link” height=”500″ width=”100%”]

Note: You may also specify the style parameters with an inline CSS style for the frame.
